    condition:
        all of ($beacon_*) and $header_host and $header_useragent
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Profile {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS based on JA3/S patterns and URI structure"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://github.com/Cobalt-Strike/C2-Profiles"

        $j = { 0d 0a 56 69 61 3a 20 31 2e 31 20 } // "\r\nVia: 1.1 "
    condition:
        all of ($s*) and $j
}
